title: Noise-preprocessed acceptance probability
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a tester with a finite random seed, and let $\delta\in[0,1]$. For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$, define the noise-preprocessed acceptance probability as the expected noise-preprocessed check value, where the expectation is over the tester's seed.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ has a finite seed type and a probability law on that type
